services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Up to 5 people included in each RV site. $5/person/night after the first 5 people up to a maximum of 10 people. Potomac Riverview RV site offers a great view of the Potomac and close access to our boat ramp. 30/50 amp with water & electric. Price is the same as full hook up sites. Driver must be comfortable backing up. RV campers who wish to check in BEFORE 2pm or check out AFTER 11am, may do so for a $25 fee. This option is based on site availability.
